name: mow-web-vercel-root
description: Root package.json for Vercel, whose project Root Directory setting still points here (at mood-of-wood-staff-pilot/) rather than at frontend/. Serves two purposes: (1) its vercel-build script builds the actual frontend from frontend/ (see vercel.json alongside this file), and (2) it declares the runtime dependencies for the api/ Node.js serverless functions, which Vercel's Node builder resolves from the nearest package.json above each function file.

scripts.vercel-build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
